messages:
Nina (People Ops): FYI launching the spring review cycle runbook now. Self-reviews open today and close May 2 23:59 PT. Managers: please complete manager reviews by May 9 23:59 PT. Calibration meetings are scheduled May 11-13. See runbook: https://redwood-internal/docs/reviews/runbook-spring-2026

Evan Li: thanks Nina. Quick Q who should be included in calibration for employees on parental leave?

Nina (People Ops): include them if they were active >50% of the cycle. Use the "partial-cycle" context note in the packet and call out any ramp-related expectations. We will treat parental/medical leave as documented context, not a negative signal.

Priya Rao: what about new hires who started within the last 6 weeks?

Nina (People Ops): new hires <8 weeks: managers should still submit a short touchpoint review (growth & ramp notes) but mark them as "new-hire evaluation" so calibrators know to not compare to full-cycle peers.

Samir Patel: calibration packet format? same as last time?

Nina (People Ops): slightly updated. Packet should contain:
- 1-sentence role + scope summary
- 3 impact bullets w/ links to artifacts (one should be quantitative when available)
- provisional rating (meets/exceeds/etc) + 2 concise calibration talking points
- flags: promotion candidate / stretch assignment / performance plan / partial-cycle note
Upload as a short doc or paste a doc link into the review tool.

People Ops Notifier: Reminder: Manager calibration packet deadline in 7 days (May 2). Link: https://redwood-internal/reviews/packets

Evan Li: can we get a template doc for the 3 impact bullets? want to standardize across managers.

Nina (People Ops): yes, template uploaded here: https://redwood-internal/templates/calibration-packet-template. Also a short checklist for calibration leads: 1) check evidence links 2) ensure at least one peer corroboration for >"Meets" ratings 3) note any role changes.

Priya Rao: timezone logistics: managers in APAC can't make live calibrations during US mornings. Are recordings acceptable or do we need live presence?

Nina (People Ops): live presence preferred for any promotion or contested cases. For straightforward ratings you can send a delegate or mark "submitted no-live" and the calibration lead will handle. We scheduled two repeating daily blocks during May 11-13 to maximize overlap; check the invite and RSVP.

Samir Patel: process for contested ratings after calibration? manager appeals?

Nina (People Ops): if a manager disagrees with the calibrated outcome, escalate to your Director + People Ops within 48 hours. There is a short exception panel for last-chance promotion or leveling disputes; panel decisions are final.

Evan Li: perks/logistics note: managers, ensure your team has completed the goals checkbox in the review tool. Missing goals will block final sign-off.

Nina (People Ops): final deadlines recap:
- May 2: self-reviews close (23:59 PT)
- May 2: manager calibration packet deadline (23:59 PT)
- May 9: manager reviews due (23:59 PT)
- May 11-13: calibration meetings
- May 16: ratings published to employees
Thanks all  DM me for exceptions or drop a note in #people-ops.
